Bench: Vivek Varma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:68818
Court No. - 86
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 15412 of 2022
Applicant :- Constable 1858 Chitrasain @ Raju @ Raj
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Kumar Mishra,Sukrampal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Gyanendra Singh Patel
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Second supplementary affidavit filed by learned counsel for the applicant is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Anupam Anand, learned Brief Holder for the State- opposite party no. 1, and Sri Gyanendra Singh Patel, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2.
Perused the records.

3. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings of Case No. 14126 of 2020, State v. Chitrasain @ Raju @ Raj, initiated pursuant to the cognizance order dated 22.10.2020 passed on the charge-sheet dated 22.10.2020 submitted Constable 1858 Chitrasain @ Raju @ Raj vs State Of U.P And Another on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/51263099/
1 in Case Crime No. 460 of 2020, under Sections 420, 376, 323, 504, 506, 494, 406 I.P.C., Police Station Bisrakh, District Gautam Budh Nagar pending in the Court of the District Judge, Gautam Budh Nagar as well as the order dated 15.09.2021 issuing non-bailable warrant against the applicant, on the basis of compromise.

entities.text: Court of the District Judge, Gautam Budh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the alleged victim had attained the age of majority on the date of occurrence.
Other dispute had existed between the parties and those have been resolved.
Presently, the applicant has married the victim and both are leading a happy married life having a minor daughter.
5. It is also stated that the compromise deed arrived at between the parties had been filed by the parties before the trial court.

Further, pursuant to the order dated 20.03.2023 passed by this Court,
the parties appeared before the trial Court and the court has verified the aforesaid compromise vide order dated 27.03.2023.
The copy of the compromise and the order of verification dated 27.03.2023 is annexed as Annexure- SA-2 to the second supplementary affidavit. .

6. Learned counsel for the applicant has placed reliance upon the judgment of the Supreme Court in the case of Jatin Agarwal v. State of Telangana and another, Criminal Appeal No. 456 of 2022, dated 21.03.2022, as well as the orders of this Court in Application U/s 482 No. 14068 of 2021, Irfan @
Panjabi v. State of U.P. and another, dated 02.11.2022; Application U/s 482 No. 2021, Deepak v.
State of U.P. and another, dated 15.12.2021; and Application U/s 482 No. 2286 of 2019, Parvesh Kumar @ Ravindra Chandel v. State of U.P. and others, dated 21.01.2019.
7.

entities.text: Jatin Agarwal v. State of Telangana and another, Criminal Appeal No. 456 of 2022
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text:
Irfan @
Panjabi v. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text:
Deepak v.
State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Parvesh Kumar @ Ravindra Chandel v. State of U.P. and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the applicant or the correctness of the documents relied upon by him.
He submits that he has no objection if the proceedings are quashed.

8. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case that the applicant and the victim are leading a happy married life and the parties have entered into a compromise, and also in the light of the decisions referred above, to secure the ends of the justice the proceedings of the aforesaid case are quashed.
9. Accordingly, the present application is allowed.
